confidence_strata.S1_same_panel_single: both cells share a panel and each has panel_count == 1
confidence_strata.S2_same_panel_multi: both cells share a panel, at least one has panel_count > 1
confidence_strata.S3_cross_panel: no shared panel; weak/noise stratum, never pooled into the primary bank
confidence_strata.rule: defined by provenance only, so no label value can move a pair between strata

bootstrap_ci.note: bootstrap unit is the repeated-measure group; residual rows are not treated as independent

difference_label_uncertainty.caveat: both terms are estimated on small, selected subsets; the cross-panel figure is the one that matters for the S3 stratum and it is the weaker of the two estimates
difference_label_uncertainty.model: delta_y = y_b - y_a with each y an aggregated median. A between-assay offset shared by both cells of a same-panel pair cancels in the difference; it does not cancel for a cross-panel pair.

bootstrap_ci.note: bootstrap unit is the repeated-measure group; residual rows are not treated as independent

identifiability_limits.curation_duplication: a large zero-range share means one physical measurement curated under two article DOIs; the pooled dispersion is deflated by them.
identifiability_limits.not_an_mse_floor: None of this bounds achievable model error. It bounds how much of the supervision is reproducible on the compounds that happen to be measured twice.
identifiability_limits.single_measurement_cells: 96% of meta_train cells carry exactly one source row, so their measurement error is not observable at all. Every number here is conditional on the repeated-measure subset.
identifiability_limits.technical_vs_condition_variation: NOT IDENTIFIABLE. If the projection's assay protocol_sha256 never splits a meta_train panel into two protocols (L2 groups = 0), the provenance cannot separate a technical replicate from the same paper reporting two measurements under different conditions.

duplication.note: a zero-range group is one physical measurement curated more than once; it is evidence of duplication, not of agreement, and it biases the pooled dispersion downwards

group_range.reason: L2 ranges: only 0 independent groups; the dispersion is not identifiable and no value is invented

residuals_from_group_median.reason: L2 residuals: only 0 independent groups; the dispersion is not identifiable and no value is invented

L3_across_panels.definition: per-panel medians of one (target, ligand), i.e. the inputs to the corpus's equal-panel median

duplication.note: a zero-range group is one physical measurement curated more than once; it is evidence of duplication, not of agreement, and it biases the pooled dispersion downwards

not_a_claim: these dispersions are repeated-measure variability on the subset of compounds that happen to be measured more than once. They are NOT a universal benchmark MSE floor, NOT an irreducible prediction error, and must never be quoted as either.

isolation.allow_list_source: physically isolated split view, meta_train only
isolation.why: exact_labels.jsonl.gz is a single all-label artifact; the allow-list is applied in the same pass that parses it, so no non-meta_train value is ever bound to a retained structure. This is weaker than the model path's physical isolation and is reported as such.

purpose: measure the reliability of the governed pK supervision at the provenance levels the corpus distinguishes

selection_bias.warning: a (target, ligand) pair appears twice only if two groups chose to measure it, which favours reference compounds and well-studied targets. The corpus additionally dropped rows at admission, so any disagreement estimate here is a LOWER bound on the disagreement in the raw source.
